question: Six times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 46 years. After 10 years, six times Q’s age will be 18 years less than five times P’s age at that time. What is the present age of Q (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From the first condition, 6P = Q + 46 ⇒ P = (Q + 46) ÷ 6.

Since ages are generally whole numbers, (Q + 46) must be a multiple of 6.

Checking the options: If Q = 2, then P = (2 + 46) ÷ 6 = 48 ÷ 6 = 8 (Integer).

For other options (Q = 1, 6, 5), P is not an integer.

Verifying Q = 2, P = 8 in the 2nd condition: 6 × (2 + 10) = 72 and 5 × (8 + 10) − 18 = 72 (Matches!).

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Six times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 46 years.

After 10 years, six times Q's age will be 18 years less than five times P's age.
